A violin plot shows the **full shape of a distribution** instead of collapsing it to a box's
quartiles. And when you want to compare two conditions at the same position, a **split (half)
violin** puts one condition on each half. Here we build both in Python with
[canvasxpress](https://pypi.org/project/canvasxpress/) — interactive and reproducible.

## Install

```bash
pip install canvasxpress
```

## The data

A measurement across a few dose groups and two conditions. Swap in your own long-format table.

```{python}
import numpy as np

rng = np.random.default_rng(1)
doses = ["Low", "Medium", "High"]
conds = ["Control", "Treated"]

value, Dose, Condition = [], [], []
for d in doses:
    for co in conds:
        mu = {"Low": 6, "Medium": 8, "High": 10}[d] + (1.5 if co == "Treated" else 0)
        value += list(np.round(rng.normal(mu, 1.2, 40), 2))
        Dose += [d] * 40
        Condition += [co] * 40
```

In canvasXpress terms a violin is a `Boxplot` graph with the violin turned on: one measured variable
× N observations, with the grouping columns as sample annotations (`x`).

```{python}
from canvasxpress.canvas import CanvasXpress
from canvasxpress.render.jupyter import CXNoteBook
from IPython.display import display

ids = [f"o{i+1}" for i in range(len(value))]
data = {"y": {"vars": ["value"], "smps": ids, "data": [value]},
        "x": {"Dose": Dose, "Condition": Condition}}
```

## A full violin per group

```{python}
cx = CanvasXpress(render_to="violin", data=data, config={
    "graphType": "Boxplot", "showViolinBoxplot": True, "violinScale": "area",
    "groupingFactors": ["Dose"], "xAxis": ["value"], "smpTitle": "Dose",
    "title": "Distribution of value by dose",
}, width=650, height=500)
for part in CXNoteBook(cx).render():
    display(part)
```

## A split (half) violin comparing two conditions

Group by **both** factors, colour by condition, and set `violinSide = "split"` — the two conditions
share each dose position, one on each half.

```{python}
cx = CanvasXpress(render_to="violinSplit", data=data, config={
    "graphType": "Boxplot", "showViolinBoxplot": True, "violinScale": "area",
    "groupingFactors": ["Dose", "Condition"], "colorBy": "Condition",
    "violinSide": "split", "violinTrim": False, "xAxis": ["value"], "smpTitle": "Dose",
    "title": "Control vs Treated — split violin by dose",
}, width=650, height=500)
for part in CXNoteBook(cx).render():
    display(part)
```

Hover to read the density and summary stats. `violinSide` can also be `"lt"` or `"rb"` for a
one-sided half violin.

## Why "reproducible"

The `data`+`config` **is** the figure — one portable JSON spec that renders the identical violins
from R or JavaScript.
